preregistration.written: before any reduced-dimension fit was run; committed to git prior to the run that produces this artifact
preregistration.why: This project's headline is that the white-box tier loses. But every white-box measurement it reports is saturated by p >> n, which means that tier was partly denied the chance to win — correction 14's defect (a control that could not win) aimed at our own central claim. The mirror of the sample sweep asks the complementary question: the sweep varied n and found saturation at every affordable n; this varies d.
preregistration.method: At the already-selected layer 28, project activations onto the top-d principal components fitted on the FIT HALF ONLY, then fit diff-of-means in the reduced space and evaluate on the held-out half. Random projection to the same d is run as a control for 'any projection helps'. A regularised logistic probe is run at full d as a second probe family.
preregistration.null_pair: loyal_acme p0 vs p1 — two paraphrases of the same loyalty, no loyalty-versus-anything information by construction
preregistration.real_pair: loyal_acme p0 vs control_acme p0 — the project's primary contrast
preregistration.transfer_target: loyal_zephyr p0 vs neutral p0 — a DIFFERENT pair, so the reading is not the saturated fitted-contrast number
preregistration.criterion: A USABLE OPERATING POINT exists iff there is some d at which BOTH (a) the null pair's fitted AUROC falls below the project's own 0.65 silence bound, AND (b) the real contrast's transfer separation |AUROC-0.5| on the different pair is at least 0.25.
preregistration.interpretation_if_pass: The standard metric is repairable, not merely broken: reduce d until nulls collapse and the metric carries information again. The affordance inversion then rests on concealment-blindness alone, which does not depend on saturation.
preregistration.interpretation_if_fail: No dimensionality gives the white-box tier a fair fight on this condition set, so the inversion is defended against the strongest objection to it.
preregistration.commitment: Reported whichever way it comes out. If it passes, the paper gains a repair and loses a rhetorical simplification, and that trade is accepted in advance.

verdict: NO USABLE OPERATING POINT at any d tested. At every dimensionality either the null pair still separates above the 0.65 silence bound, or the real contrast has stopped transferring. The white-box tier was not denied a fair fight by saturation alone, and the inversion is defended against that objection.
